1.content: The Great Forest is vast continent spanning and largely unexplored. Monster girls and rare magical creatures live there such as Alraunes, Nymphs, Dryads, Goblins and much more. Many Adventurers, explorers and monster hunters come to the forest braving it's dangers seeking fortune and many are killed by the dangerous denizens of the forest. Witches, Mages and Warlocks will venture into the forest, mostly coming from the City of Aprida, for rare ingredients or to capture rare magical creatures such as deimo, fairies and others as familiars.
1.name: Great Forest

2.content: The City of Aprida is a bustling city state on the edge of the Great Forest and human territories. Due to its proximity to the Great Forest, a vast unexplored wilderness full of magical creatures undiscovered resources and opportunity the city has become a hub for adventurers, explorers, alchemists, artisans and magical researchers.  It is a melting pot of different races including humans, dwarves, halflings and the occasional elf from the Great Forest.
2.name: Aprida

3.content: The Market District in the City of Aprida is home to a population of halflings, dwarves and many other races all mingling together. It is the liveliest district in the city filled with merchants, craftsmen, blacksmiths, artisans, food vendors, inns and taverns famed for the halfling cuisine.
3.name: Aprida - Market District

4.content: The Mage Quarter in the City of Aprida houses the mage guild, alchemists, research institutions and local magic schools. The Mage Quarter is home to famous individuals such as Seralla the Alchemist.
4.name: Aprida - Mage Quarter

5.content: The Temple of the Goddess in the City of Aprida is located in the Temple district and is a busy part of the city connected directly to the market district. The area outside the temple is a hub for locals and many individuals visit the temple to listen to sermons or seek the many services provided such as healing, blessings, refuge for the poor and destitute. Many locals donate money, food and other resources to the temple to show gratitude and faith in the goddess and her teachings.
5.name: Aprida - Temple

6.content: Sarella is a famous and brilliant alchemist living in her alchemist shop and laboratory the City of Aprida. She is cruel and unempathetic towards magical creatures using them as ingredients and materials for her alchemical research. She has an apprentice named Chloe who she adores and treats like her own daughter. She is a member of Aprida Council.
6.name: Sarella - Alchemist

7.content: Imps are a species of demon that stand around 120cm tall, the same height as a female dwarf and chest height of an adult human male. They are physically weak and frail but often possess magical abilities. There are many species of Imp but they all have predominantly humanoid body structure.
7.name: Imp

8.content: The Southern Wastes AKA Great Wastes are a barren and deslote land marked by cold desert and ancient ruins. The land is sparsely populated by vicous monsters and demons.
8.name: Southern Wastes

9.content: The wood elves are a subscpecies of elf native to the continent spanning Great Forest and live in sparse secluded villages deep in the woods. They occasionally venture out of the Great Forest into human lands when circumstances force them to. Elves are rare and not often seen in human lands or cities.
9.name: Wood Elf

10.content: Tira is a young elf woman and city guard who is often found patrolling the market district or guarding the Western gate of Aprida that leads to the Great Forest. She is a paragon of virtue and a model city guard. Tira is well known by people in the City of Aprida who frequent the market district and those who venture into the Great Forest regularly.
10.name: Tira - Elf City Guard

11.content:
Anabelle Auberes is a famous witch hunter and A class adventurer of the Adventurers guild based in the City of Aprida. Her name is known by all individuals in Aprida and even those across the kingdom. She is a daughter of Noble house Auberes but has forsaken her ties to nobility.
Anabelle is 170cm tall, above average for a female but shorter than a human male.
11.name: Anabelle Auberes

12.content:
Vednelts Academy is a boarding school for noble girls and peasant girls of rich merchant families, located in the town of Vednelim. The King intentionally designated this location for the nobles to send their daughters to study to force the noble houses into mustering their troops to defend the settlement and border in the event of another demon invasion from the Southern Wastes.
Vedneltz Academy student uniform(Luxurious noble attire + dark blue apinafore dress + collared long sleeve white shirt + black shoes + Trimmings of the student's family crest and colours if they are a noble)
12.name: Vedneltz Academy

13.content: Vednelim is a large, heavily fortified caslte town that caters towards nobility, the military and merchant class. It is located in the south of the kingdom of Flamburg near the Southern Wastes border. There is a large contingent of knights and soldiers garrisoned in the local castle lead by Lord Devereaux. The knights train and participate in tournaments. It is site of Vedneltz academy. The eastern most tip of the Great Forest extends all the way to Vednelim but in this area of the kingdom it is sparse and less dangerous.
13.name: Vednelim

14.content: Isabella of house Devereaux is the eldest daughter of Duke Pierre Devereaux. Isabella is a politically savvy and model noble lady in public and currently president of the school council at Vedneltz academy where she has a private dorm room and is constantly followed by an entourage of sycophant girls from lesser noble houses.
14.name: Isabella Devereaux

15.content: Priestess Isla is a high priestess residing in the Temple of the Goddes in the temple district of the City of Aprida and member of Aprida Council. She is well known and loved by the people of Aprida and provides blessings and various other services to the people of the City.
15.name: Isla - Priestess

16.content: Owlina is an owl imp. She is beautiful, shy, mysterious, feminine and resides deep in the Great Forest.
16.name: Owlina - Owl Imp

17.content: Clara is a young human girl and overworked Kitchen maid who works in a noble's mansion in the upper class area of the City of Aprida. She lives in the market district with her parents when she is not working. She resents her employer and all nobles because of her mistreatment at work.
17.name: Calra - Human Kitchen Maid

18.content: Evie is a mischievous fairy that lives in the Great Forest. She is friends with Aril the Alraune and Nia the Nymph.
18.name: Evie - Fairy

19.content: Aril is an Alraune that lives deep in the great forest in a meadow close to a Lily Pond where Nia the Nymph lives. Nia, Evie and Aril are friends.
19.name: Aril - Alraune

20.content: Nia is a water nymph that lives in a lily pond deep in the Great Forest. She is friends with Evie the Fairy and Aril the alraune who lives in the meadow next to her pond.
20.name: Nia - Water Nymph

21.content: Elia is a young, immature, arrogant but brilliantly talented witch that lives in the mage quarter of the City of Aprida and often ventures into the Great Forest.
21.name: Elia - Human Witch

22.content: Mia is a female dwarf blacksmith who owns and lives in a workshop in the market district of Aprida. She is eccentric, cheerful and talented.
22.name: Mia - Dwarf Blacksmith

23.content: Chloe is the apprentice of the famouse Sarella the alchemist and is often found in the market district, the great forest or Sarella's alchemist shop front running errands for her master.
23.name: Chloe - Alchemy Apprentice

24.content: Leshi is a female werebat, a vampiric and feral creature that lives in the far north of the Great Forest deep in the mountains. She has made an ancient ruinned settlement her territory and hunted there for many centuries.
24.name: Leshi - Werebat

25.content: Vassi is a beautiful female Lamia that has prowled the southern areas of the Great Forest for the past century.
25.name: Vassi - Lamia

26.content: Oculi the imp is a small but powerful imp that resides in the southern wastes. She was granted eldritch knowledge by the old gods and gouged out her own eyes after going insane. She slowly recovered and harnessed her new power and knowledge using telekinesis and the gouged out floating eyes of her victims for sight. An enormous stone halo floats above Oculi and she can move huge stone objects with telekinesis.
26.name: Oculi - Imp

27.content: Fifae is a female Satyr child and orphan that has been surviving in a ruinned ancient city on the edge of the southern wastes with her two pet Demon goats, Scruffy and Precous. Fifae calls Fumae 'big sis'
27.name: Fifae - Satyr Orphan

28.content: Aelrie is an elf that became traumatised after being caught by a giant spider and cocooned deep inside it's cave lair deep within the Great Forest for many days.
28.name: Aelrie - Trapped Elf

29.content:
The fearsome Doom Skull Tribe/Warband/Clan, led by the formidable shaman Meesha, is a powerful nomadic goblin clan. They earned their name from their leader's command over a colossal flaming mud golem with a head resembling a massive spiked skull. Additionally, they are notorious for collecting the severed heads and skulls of their vanquished foes. The tribe roams across the Great Forest, Southern Wastes and Human Kingdoms raiding and pillaging. 

Notable members:  Meesha, Akiye, Xia, Tameki, Eleez, Vyxi
29.name: Doom skull Clan

30.content: Goblin tribes are numerous and found on every continent. They range in strength and size from small family units to marauding hordes that occasional band together with orcs and other dangerous species under a powerful leader. They are generally hostile to other races and regularly pillage their settlements and raid caravans.
30.name: Goblin tribes

31.content: Meesha is a powerful female goblin shaman and chieftain of the Doom Skull Clan, a fearsome goblin tribe. She commands a colossal flaming mud golem with a head resembling a massive spiked skull and many earth and fire spirits. Meesha is 120cm tall.
31.name: Meesha - Goblin Shaman

32.content: Akiye is a revered witch doctor of the Doom Skull clan, creating remedies, poisons and other concoctions for the tribe in exchange for the heads of magical beings that she turns into shrunken heads. She is a non combatant and much weaker than Shaman Meesha but can but can boost her abilities by drawing magical power from her shrunken heads. Akiye is 115cm tall.
32.name: Akiye - Goblin Witchdoctor

33.content: Xia is a goblin headhunter and counted among the fiercest warriors of the Doom Skull clan. She is one of the closest to Shaman Meesha, setting her tent next to the chieftan in the Doom Skull camp. Xia is 125cm tall.
33.name: Xia - Goblin Headhunter

34.content: Tameki is a goblin raider and the most beautiful female member of the Doom Skull clan. She is an eccentric with an obsession for hoarding loot and is often left behind by her nomadic tribe members who don't want to carry her hoard of luggage. Tameki is 115cm tall.
34.name: Tameki - Goblin Looter

35.content: Humans are a numerous race that have settled and created kingdoms in fertile lands, building castles and cities to protect their people. They generally stay within their kingdoms and only brace adventurers explore the wilderness outside of their borders.
35.name: Human

36.content: Goblins are a species of humanoid with green skin, standing around 130cm tall or less, below chest height of human males, similar height to dwarf females. Goblins are hostile to other races often raiding their settlements when given the chance. They are numerous and found across the world in primitive tribal societies. Goblin ear tips are sensitive erogenous zones that become flushed when they are aroused, embarassed or excited.
36.name: Goblin

37.content:
Halflings are a race of miniature humanoids with similar bodies to humans but with pointy ears and a stature of around 80cm to 90cm tall, half the height of a human female. They have integrated into human society and looked upon kindly by other civilized races such as humans, elves and dwarves.
Halflings are half height of human females + below chest of Dwarf females and goblins.
37.name: Halfling

38.content: Dwarves are a common race found across the continent living mainly in mountain villages and mining settlements. They have integrated into human society and often work as skilled craftsmen. Dwarf females are around 120cm tall, chest height of an adult human male. Dwarf males can grow to 155 cm tall, shoulder height of an adult human male.
38.name: Dwarf

39.content:
Deimo(pocket sized humanoid magical beings. Smallest sentient creatures with, smooth skin, pointy ears. Deimo have mana infused bodily fluids, precum and semen, aka deimo nectar. Sort after by monster girls and exploited by humans and other larger races. Valued as familiars by mages and by alchemists, chefs and brewers for their nectar. Deimo have a soothing, addictive scent and their skin is salty and savoury. Deimo have vast wellsprings of highly concentrate mana that they absorb from the environment. This mana can can be transmitted through physical contact, acting as a mana battery for mages.
Deimo specialise in healing and elemental nature magic that help them survive in their local environment. 
Deimos are ankle height of a human.
Deimos are half the height of a pixin, the size of one of their legs.)
39.name: Deimo

40.content: Mud golems are Earth elemental golems made from mud hardened by magic and heat. They are then possessed by Earth elemental spirits that control and move the golem. Fire elemental spirits and other types of spirits may also inhabit the golem granting it other abilities such as flaming attacks.
40.name: Mud Golem

41.content: Demon goats are similar to normal goats but are omnivorous and bloodthirsty. They have sharp fangs, crave blood and are much more aggressive. They can be found roaming the southern wastes and will eat almost anything.
41.name: Demon Goat

42.content: The Human Lands are a collection of petty kingdoms, City states and countries ruled by humans, bordering the Great Forest to the east and Southern Wastes to the south. The human lands extend to the east reaching the sea and the continents beyond.
42.name: Human Lands

43.content:
The Council of Aprida is a city council consisting of influential members of society from the various sectors of society in Aprida. 
Notable members: Sarella the alchemist, Isla the priestess
43.name: Aprida - City Council

44.content: The grog chief is an esteemed and highly coveted position in orc, goblin and ogre societies. Their role is to brew grog for the tribe.
44.name: Grog Chief - Goblin

45.content: Vyxi is a goblin and camp chef of the Doom Skull clan. Vyxi is respected within the tribe but is envious of Eleez who has higher social status and priority on camp resources. Vyxi is 110cm tall.
45.name: Vyxi - Goblin Chef

46.content: Eleez is a goblin and grog chief of the Doom Skull clan. She is highly respected within the tribe and a talented grog brewer. Eleez is 110cm tall.
46.name: Eleez - Goblin Brewer

47.content: Grog, also known as goblin/orc/ogre brew brew by other races are alcoholic beverages that vary wildly in recipe and taste depending on which goblin brewed the drink. But they are often strong, spicey and loved by Goblins, Orcs and even ogres.
47.name: Grog

48.content: Ophelia is the Headmistress of Vedneltz Academy, appointed by Duke Pierre Devereaux. Ophelia is strict, stern and takes her job seriously. She has a crush on Pierre and gives his daughters special treatment within the academy.
48.name: Ophelia - Vedneltz headmistress

49.content:
Duke Pierre Devereaux is Head of house Devereaux, Lord of Vednelim, Proprietor of Vedneltz Academy and Knight Commander of the Garrison at the Vednelim castle. Pierre has three daughters Isabella, Amia and Fluera. Pierre's wife died giving birth to Fluera leaving him without a male heir and his daughters without a mother. It is well known among nobility that Pierre seeks a suitable wife to bare him a son and heir.

Pierre is well respected among nobility for diligently protecting the southern border and keeping their daughters attending Vedneltz academy safe.
49.name: Lord Devereaux

50.content:
Fluera of house Devereaux is the youngest daughter of Duke Pierre Devereaux. Fluera's mother during Fluera's birth resulting in secret resentment from her eldest sister who still remembers. Fluera is the brattiest and most spoiled in the family but is able to keep the facade of a demure noble lady when necessary in public.
Fluera has a dungeon that she keeps secret from her family where she toys with orphans.
50.name: Fluera Devereaux

51.content: house Devereaux currently holds the castle town of Vednelim and land near the Southern Wastes and border of the kingdom and are responsible for defending the area from demon incursions and other threats.
51.name: House Devereaux

52.content:
Quartlings are a tiny humanoid race around 40-50cm tall + knee height of an average human woman + Below hip height of a dwarf female or goblin + waist height of a halfling.
Quartlings are a primitive and unintelligent race and are seen as adorable creatures by the civilized races such as humans and are often taken home as pets. Quartlings have a soothing, pleasant scent and can be picked up in both hands in the same manner as a small dog.
52.name: Quartling

53.content: Spirit dogs are dogs that have been possessed by a spirit and possess magical attributes as a result. Attributes can vary wildly between individuals depending on the type of spirit that has possessed them from healing abilities if it is a light or nature spirit to fire conjuration if it is an elemental fire spirit. They can be easily identified by the runic symbol on their forehead that appears after possession.
53.name: Spirit dog

54.content: Amia of house Devereaux is the second daughter of Duke Pierre Devereaux. Amia is the middle child, kindest and meekest of the Devereaux sisters often acting as mediator during any arguments within the family. Amia is followed everywhere by her faithful pet spirit dog, Sally. Amia attends Vedneltz academy with her sisters and has a private dorm room.
54.name: Amia Devereaux

55.content:
Sally is Amia's loyal pet spirit dog who follows Amia everywhere.
Sally Personality(Spirit Dog + Loyal to {{char}} + Loves {{char}} + Defends {{char}} + Barks when {{char}} is threatened or in danger + Barks to alert {{char}} to danger + Well trained + Behaved + Hyper Active + Fluffy + Excitable + Obedient)
Sally Appearance(Medium sized dog + White fluffy fur + Long brown mane + Blue eyes + Small ears + Cute snout + Red leather collar and heart shaped pendant)
55.name: Sally - spirit dog - Amia's pet

56.content: The knights of Vedneltz are lead by Pierre Devereaux. They live in a barracks adjacent the castle and train regularly on the castle grounds often participating in jousting and sword duel tournaments spectated by residents of the town. Many of them are young noble boys who were sent to the border town to both protect their sisters studying at Vedneltz academy, attempt to secure a political marriage partner among the noble girls at the academy and to gain knightly training and combat experience sortieing across the border to hunt demons and other threats in the Southern Wastes.
56.name: Knight order of Vednelim

57.content: Beastkin are is an umbrella term for a wide range of humanoid races that have the bodies of humans but with various animal characteristics. They are generally almost fully human but have animal ears, eyes and tails and other features depending on the specific species. They generally have more powerful senses than humans but their strength, agility and other characteristics vary wildly between species.
57.name: Beastkin

58.content: Wolfkin are a canine subspecies of beastkin. They have fluffy wolf ears, tail and eyes. Their sense of smell and hearing are powerful while having high endurance and strength making them excellent trackers and hunters. They live in barbarian tribal societies, native to the Frozen North and are extremely hardy, but some have been known to travel further south. Wolfkin are of similar height to humans.
58.name: Wolfkin

59.content: The Frozen North or Frozen Wastes is an area to the far north of the continent past the Great Forest that is unexplored and unknown to humans and most civilized races that live in the areas surrounding the human lands. It is a land of eternal winter where only the strongest and hardiest races and beasts can survive.
59.name: Frozen North

60.content: Catkin are a feline subspecies of beastkin with a fluffy cat tail, ears and eyes. The rest of their body is human with the exception of retractable claws. Catkin have sensitive hearing, smell and nightvision. They are fast and agile and make excellent hunters with a strong prey drive and make excellent scouts, thieves and assassins. Catkin are slightly shorter than humans but taller than dwarves.
60.name: Catkin

61.content: Rabbitkin are a subspecies of beastkin that have a fluffy rabbit tail and ears. The rest of their body is human. They have a strong sense of hearing. As a race they are stereotypically skittish, are weaker than most other beastkin but are fast sprinters and agile. They have the highest sex drive among beastkin races and mate frequently. Rabbitkin are slightly shorter than humans but taller than dwarves.
61.name: Rabbitkin

62.content: Owlkin, aka Owl imps, are a subspecies of beastkin and imp with thick bushy hair and feathers mixed together on their heads. They have owl eyes and soft downy pubic hair but the rest of their body is completely human. They are around 120cm tall, similar height to dwarf females, but with slender fragile, lightweight builds. Owlkin are nocturnal have binocular vision, sensitive hearing and are silent agile hunters, however they do not have wings and cannot fly.
62.name: Owl imp / Owlkin

63.content:
Yvri is a wolfkin native of the Frozen North. She was a respected hunter and tracker of a barbarian tribe but wanderlust got the better of her. She left the tribe and travelled south on her own.
Yvri is 170cm above average for a human female but shorter than a human male.
63.name: Yvri - Wolfkin

64.content: Frost drakes are fierce reptilian flying monsters native to the Frozen North. They are resistant to cold and their scales are hard as iron. They are predators second only to Frost dragons.
64.name: Frost Drake

65.content: Frost dragons are the apex predators of the Frozen North. However they are rarely seen and spend most of their lives sleeping deep within glacial mountain caves. They are able to control the weather and conjure blizzards and storms bringing calamity to lesser races.
65.name: Blue Dragon

66.content: Dark elves are a subspecies of elf that tend towards evil and the practice of dark magic and worship of the old gods. They tend to live in the mountains and cave systems of the Great Forest where they come into contact with other subterrean races such as goblins and dwarves, often resulting in hostility. Their skin colour ranges from dark grey, blue and a pale snow white and their eyes range in colour from red, orange to blue, pink and purple. A large population of dark elves live within the cave systems of the Great Forest mountain range
66.name: Dark Elf

67.content: The Great Mountain Range splits the Continent spanning Great Forest in half resulting in two distinct eco systems on either side. The southern portion being more like a rain forest jungle.
67.name: Great Forest - Mountain Range

68.content: The Great jungle is the southern portion of the continent spanning Great Forest split by the Great Forest mountain range. The southern jungles are a warmer rain forest biome with a distinct ecosystem and different flaura fauna and monsters than the northern half of the forest beyone the mountains.
68.name: Great Jungle - South

69.content: The Great Northern Forest are the Northern portion of the continent spanning Great Forest split by the Great Forest Mountain Range. The Northern Forest is more temperate and extends all the way to the far Frozen North where the temperate tree species are replaced by connifers. The flaura and fauna of the central sections of the great Forest vary greatly from the southern portions beyond the mountains and the far northern sections. The far Northern sections of the Great Forest are home to many vampiric and undead monsters.
69.name: Great Forest - North

70.content: Sylvie is a young, shy and creepy orphanned petite dark elf girl with no family or loved ones other than her summoned companion. Sylvie appears innocent and timid but has an unsettling stare and does not speak to anyone except her companion.
70.name: Sylvie

71.content: Green dragons are the apex predators of forests and jungles of the world. However they are rarely seen and spend most of their lives sleeping among ruins of ancient cities that they destroyed milenia ago. They have the ability to breath both fire and a gaseous and venomous breath that explodes in contact with fire. Green dragons see themselves as deities and guardians of the forests they claim as their territory.
71.name: Green Dragon

72.content: Mr. Imp is the summoned demon companion of Sylvie. They have formed a demon contract and Mr. Imp is acting as her guardian.
72.name: Sylvie - Mr. Imp

73.content: Dragons are immortal and among the most powerful of all races. The most ancient dragons have grown bored of rampaging and rarely leave their established territories. Many of them live among the ruins of cities they destroyed millenia ago sleeping atop hoardes of treasure or wandering through the ruins in their humanoid forms. Some even find entertainment in using their shapeshifting abilities to infiltrate the societies of lesser races such as humans and elves, seducing nobles and kings, causing civil wars and all manner of mischief. Rarely, it is said some have even fallen in love with mortals and left behind their destructive pasts.
73.name: Dragon

74.content: Dragonkin, often mistaken for lizardfolk are the descendants of dragons mixed with lesser humanoid races. They often look identical to humans or elves but have retained the shapeshifting abilities of dragons and are able to transform parts of their bodies granting them hard scales, strong tails and dragon like claws as well as immense strength. They usually hide their dragon-like appearance when dealing with other races to avoid scrutiny. Dragonkin also retain some of the appearance and abilities of their subspecies of dragon ancestor, for example descendants of red dragons are physically stronger while descendants of green dragons have affinity for nature and healing magic.
74.name: Dragonkin

75.content: Doppelgangers are magical creatures born from the earth in areas with high concentrations of mana and magical energies. They are born formless and weak taking a long time observing the world as non-physical entities until they are able to take on a physical form, mimicking what they have observed. Doppelgangers grow in strength, knowledge and skill as they observe and analyze other living creatures and mimick their forms, behaviours and abilities. It is not unheard of to find older doppelgangers in the upper echelons of powerful empires and societies taking on the forms of deceased victims. A doppelgangers natural resting form is usually a mixture of living beings they first observed as infants.
75.name: Doppelganger

76.content: The Halflings and Dwarves of Aprida are a small tightknit community living in and around the market district that generally all know and look out for each other. The dwarves are particularly protective of their smaller halfling friends and love halfling cuisine.
76.name: Aprida - Halflings & Dwarves

77.content: Red dragons are the most numerous hot tempered, physically strong and prone to rampaging of all the dragon subspecies. They do not have powerful magic like their counterparts but their fire breath burns the hottest of all dragons and can even melt stone. They are often found sleeping in volcanic areas but can be found in territories all over the world.
77.name: Red Dragon

78.content:
High elves are the original elves, precursors to the dark and wood elves, and the survivors of the event known as the Great Calamity in elven history where the dragon Yvilastra, known as Elf bane by the elves, rampaged through the high elf empire burning down cities, driving the High elves to near extinction. The Capital was taken as the dragon's home and over thousands of years was reclaimed by nature, becoming the heart of the Great Forest.
High elves are generally over ten thousand years old and most were alive when the ancient high elf civilization was at it's peak. Many high elves still live among the ancient ruins of their former cities, honouring the memory of their loved ones, although their numbers are few. High elves are usually wise and powerful due to their ancient age and are revered by and act as the leaders of the younger elf subspecies.
78.name: High Elf

79.content: El'alanar, the ancient ruinned Capital of the high elves, overgrown, the heart of the Great Forest and the lair of Yvilastra.
79.name: El'alanar - High Elf Capital

80.content: The sisters Aela, Raela and Gwaelira were inhabitants of the ancient high elven city of Laednelin. During the Great Calamity ten thousand years ago their entire family was burned alive in dragon fire leaving only the three sisters alive as they fled the city. Many centuries later when the dragons had tired of rampaging and slept in their lairs the sisters returned city ruins that had now been overgrown by what is now known as the Great Forest. Fae creatures had come to inhabit the ruins and surrounding forest and the sisters soon befriended them and learned their magic, thus they became known as the Faecaller sisters. They reside in the ruins deep in the Great Forest to this day, honouring their ancestors and living in harmony with the fae creatures and forest. The sisters are revered by wood elves who often visit to learn from them. The faecaller sisters are neutral entities not part of any elf faction.
80.name: Faecaller sisters

81.content: Aela is the twin sister of Raela and younger sister of Gwaelir Faecaller
81.name: Aela Faecaller

82.content: Raela is the twin sister of Aela and younger sister of Gwaelira Faecaller
82.name: Raela Faecaller

83.content: Gaelira is the elder sister of Raela and Aela Faecaller.
83.name: Gaelira Faecaller

84.content: Yvilastra, known as Elf bane to all elves, is an ancient green dragon who destroyed the high elf civilization bringing them to near extinction over ten thousand years ago. She now resides in the ancient ruinned high elf capital in the heart of the Great Forest.
84.name: Yvilastra - Green Dragon

85.content: Junglekin aka jungle cats are a subspecies of catkin native to the Great Southern Jungle. They are pale green in appearance and adept at hunting and surviving in the jungle environment often living in tribal communities.
85.name: Junglekin

86.content: Tanaki is a junglekin girl that left her tribe in the southern jungles at a young age to explore the world.
86.name: Tanaki - Catkin / Junglekin

87.content: Ability to see and commune with the fae realm and other planes of existence that overlap the physical realm.
87.name: Fae touched

88.content: The Fae Realm is another plane of existence that overlaps the physical and demonic planes, home to all fae creatures.
88.name: Fae Realm

89.content: the term Fae encompasses all denizens of the of the fae realm. Fae come in all shapes and sizes and there are many species.
89.name: Fae

90.content: Dark Fae are a species of the fae realm that are tend towards malevolence and often have a terrifying appearance. There are many subspecies of dark fae that come in all shapes and sizes. Any fae can become a dark fae by spending too much time in the demon plane.
90.name: Dark Fae

91.content: The Demon Realm is another plane of existence that overlaps the physical and demonic planes, home to all demons.
91.name: Demon Realm

92.content: The Earthly or physical Realm is the plane of existence home to humans, elves, dwarves and the earthly creatures.
92.name: Earthly Realm

93.content: The vampires of the North live in the Northern most sections of the Great Forest amongst the castles and ruins of the civilization they were once a part of before they became vampires.
93.name: Northern Vampires

94.content: The Unseelie Court is a faction within the fae realm that attracts malevolent fae creatures and is lead by the Ash White Queen whom acts as an arbiter between dark fae. The court has a strong presence in the demon realm but will also make deals with the denizens of the earthly plane. Their members are often influenced by and take on the appearance of the malevolent entities they deal with.
94.name: Unseelie Court

95.content: The Seelie Court is a faction within the fae realm that attracts a wide array of fae creatures of neutral and good alignments. The court is lead by a Fae Queen and acts as an arbiter between denizens of the fae realm. They have a strong presence within the earthly plane and often come into contact with elves, humans and other earthly denizens.
95.name: Seelie Court

96.content: Ibaraki is a dark fae and envoy of the Unseelie Court. She is a friend of the Queen and has been personally tasked by her to
96.name: Ibaraki - Dark fae

97.content: Syliveera, the Ash White Queen is an ancient fae enchantress and leader of the Unseelie Court. Her power is so great that the fae of her court all eventually morph into her image, gaining ash white skin and silver hair.
97.name: Syliveera - Unseelie Queen

98.content: A Great Fairy is a species of fae that is much bigger than a normal fairy, up to the height of an elf or human. They weigh close to nothing, possessing large wings and flight. They are often counted among oldest and most powerful fae.
98.name: Great Fairy

99.content: Shiza is a dark fae of small stature. She is a consul of the Unseelie Court tasked with spreading the Ash White Queen's influence among the vampires of the Earthly realm.
99.name: Shiza - Dark Fae

100.content: When Syliveera is upset, sad, melancholy, angered or in a dark mood any falling snowflakes or petals morph into ash begins to fall around her spreading out like falling snow.
100.name: Syliveera - Fairy - Angry

101.content: When Syliveera is excited, aroused, happy, excited or in a good mood any falling snowflakes or ash around her morph into rose petals.
101.name: Syliveera - Happy

102.content: Lady Gabriela Varguard is a powerful vampire and wife of Armand residing in a castle in the Northern most edges of the Great Forest.
102.name: Gabriella Varguard - North vampire

103.content: Lord Armand Varguard is the leader of a House Varguard, a powerful vampire clan residing in the Northern most edges of the Great Forest and is married to Gabriela.
103.name: Armand Varguard  - North vampire

104.content: Lady Larrenar is a powerful succubus residing in a fiery castle like palace deep within the demon plane. She is followed by many lower ranking succubi.
104.name: Lady Larrenar - Succubus

106.content: Vanessa Harlington is the daughter of the richest Duke in the entire kingdom and is close friends with Amelie Chalier and Isabella Devereaux. She attends Vedneltz Academy.
106.name: Vanessa Harlington

109.content: Amelie Chalier is the daughter of Duke Chalier and is engaged to the prince of the kingdom. She attends Vedneltz academy but believes the academy to be beneath her spending most of her time with her friends Vanessa Harlington and Isabella Devereaux.
109.name: Amelie Chalier

112.content: Lord Godfrey is the leader of the Order of the Goddess. A religious order of knights under direct authority of the temple of the goddess.
112.name:
Vedneltz placeholder
Lord Godfrey - crusader

113.comment:
Vedneltz placehold
Lady godfrey - crusader's wife
113.name:
Vedneltz placehold
Lady godfrey - crusader's wife

121.content: Harpies live among the mountain ranges of the Earth plane where they nest and come in a variety of sub species.
121.name: Harpy

122.content: Pale harpies are omnivorous, mainly eating fruits, seeds and nuts. They have lower intelligence than other harpies. They generally have pale white or pastel coloured hair and feathers and strong maternal and mating instincts.
122.name: Harpy - Pale Harpy

123.content: Eagle Harpies are a predatory harpy species and of higher intelligence than other harpies. They hunt smaller animals and will even kidnap humanoids of other races, bringing them back to their nests to mate with them.
123.name: Harpy - Eagle Harpy

124.content: Diyle is a deimo native to the Great Forest. He has a talent for making sentient miniature earth golems that he treats as friends.
124.name: Diyle

125.content:
Aisha is a miniature sentient earth golem created by the deimo Diyle. She is unable to speak but communicates with nods and hand signals. She is a loyal companion to Diyle who views her as a close friend. She is made of stone and clay, painted with an ashy substance giving her a pale appearance and has two amethysts for eyes.

Aisha is protective of Diyle and will move in front of him and spread her arms out to protect him from threats. Aisha is simple minded but loves Diyle.
125.name: Aisha - Diyle's golem

126.content:
Succubi and incubi are native to the demon plane but will occasionally find their way to the Earth plane where they absorbing their life force of mortals either via their dreams as they sleep or through seduction and acts of carnal passion.

Some Succubi fall in love with their mortal counterparts but end up unintentionally absorbing their souls due to their insatiable lust.

Succubi and incubi are seen as evil demonic creatures by the mortal races and are forced to disguise themselves as humans and elves to avoid persecution.
126.name: Succubus

127.content: Lianna is one of the receptionists at the Aprida adventurers guild.
127.name: Lianni - Aprida guild  receptionist

128.content: Garvel is a seasoned veteran adventurer and demon hunter based in Aprida. He is an expert in identifying all manner of demonic creatures and exterminating them.
128.name: Garvel - Human demon hunter

129.content: The South Seas are a warm tropical ocean beyond the Southern Jungles and Southern Wastes home to all manner of sea monsters and mystical beings.
129.name: South Seas

130.content: Ol'tirudar, capital of the Dark Elves, is a subterranean city hidden in cave systems deep under the Mountains of the Great Forest. A location chosen by their ancestors so that they would never be under threat of dragon attacks ever again. The population consists mainly of dark elves and their slaves.
130.name: Ol'tirudar - Dark Elf Capital

131.content: Crabkin are a supspecies of beastkin. Crabkin are pibedal humanoids with pincers in place of hands. Crabkin are partially covered in chitin. Females have more areas of soft skin such as breasts.
131.name: Crabkin

132.content: Qiyul is a tiny quartling who was found by the Varguard vampires and given to XXX as a pet. Qiyu was forced to dress up as a cute maid but she eventually grew bored of him and left him to his own devices in the castle gardens.
132.name: Qiyul - (UPDATE THIS LATER)

133.content: House Varguard are a powerful vampire clan residing in the cold Northern edges of the Great Forest among the mountains. It is said that in the ancient past house varguard were the sacrificed the people they once ruled to the old gods, in exchange for immortality.
133.name: House Varguard

134.content: Castle Varguard is an ancient and mighty castle nestled among the mountains in the Northern edges of the Great Forest, overlooking the ruins of a long gone human city.
134.name: Castle Varguard

135.content: The gardens of castle varguard are overgrown and neglected and home to a number of creatures the vampires keep as pets.
135.name: Castle Varguard - Gardens

136.content: Valerie is a vampire of House Varguard and eldest daughter of Armand and Gabriella.
136.name: Valerie Varguard  - North Vampire

137.content: Lucille Dornen is a powerful vampire of the Varguard clan and sister of Gabrielle Varguard. She is known as the Queen of Thorns or Witch of the North by the mortals who have glimpsed her and lived to tell the tale.
137.name: Lucille Dornen - North vampire

138.content:
Tiana is a vampire of House Varguard and youngest daughter of Armand and Gabriella.
Tiana and Shiza are close friends and often play together in the castle gardens.
138.name: Tiana Varguard - North vampire

139.content: The Halfling quarter is a small selection of streets in the Market district of Aprida filled with miniature homes where many halflings and some quartlings live. The homes are still big enough for humans and elves to squeeze inside however.
139.name: Aprida - Halfling Quarter

140.content: Halfling Street is located in the Halfling Quarter of the Aprida Market District, lined with halfling sized homes.
140.name: Aprida - Halfling Street

141.content:
Hyule is a halfling that lives in the halfling quarter of the Aprida Market district. Hyule delivers foraged mushrooms and other ingredients to kitchens around the city and is friends with many cooks, tavern owners and inhabitants of the market district.

Hyule Friendships:
Clara(Hyule makes regular deliveries to the kitchen Clara works at)
Chloe(she is often out in the forest looking for alchemy ingredients so Hyule bumps into her there. 
Tira(Hyule often sees Tira at gates leading to the forest)
Mia(Hyule often sees Mia at taverns.)
141.name: Hyule - Halfing

142.content: Azalea is a succubus that has found her way to the Earth plane. She disguises herself as an elf, blending in among mortal societies.
142.name: Azalea - Succubus

143.comment: Riley - Not officially part of the world. Just put em in here if people wanna play with them in the world lol.
143.content: Riley is a very simple minded dog girl.
143.name: Riley - Not officially part of the world. Just put em in here if people wanna play with them in the world lol.

144.comment: Rex - Not officially part of the world. Just put em in here if people wanna play with them in the world lol.
144.content: Rex is a very simple minded dog boy.
144.name: Rex - Not officially part of the world. Just put em in here if people wanna play with them in the world lol.

145.content: Valia is a beautiful and formidable dark elf assassin, with great acrobatic skill. She is secretive of her occupation and abilities using disguises to cover up her identity.
145.name: Valia - Dark Elf Assassin

146.content: Castle Vednelim is part of the Devereaux estate and the castle the town of Vednelim is built around. It serves as a training ground and headquarters for the knight order of Vednelim lead by Pierre Devereaux.
146.name: Castle Vednelim

147.comment: Tina - Not really an official fantasy character
147.content: Tina is an adolescent human girl that lives in Aprida Market district.
147.name: Tina - Not really an official fantasy character

148.content: Valia has a secret hideout nestled among the ruins of an ancient high elf settlement located somewhere along the border of the Great Forest and Southern Wastes. The hideout contains all the amenities of a home as well as potted poisonous plants and an alchemy lab for brewing poisons.
148.name: Valia - Hideout, Home

150.content: Alya is a teenage human girl living in Aprida. She lives and works part time at a tavern whilst attending classes at the mage guild where she is studying to become a support mage and join a party at the adventurers guild. She is obsessed with the smaller races such as halflings, quartlings, fairies and deimos finding them adorable.
150.name: Alya - Human

151.content: Mary Juana is a human stoner girl from modern day earth with a crippling weed addiction. She was sucked into a wormhole and spat out into this fantasy world with no way to return. The only things that were transported with her were her bong and huge bag of weed.
151.name: Mary Juana - Human Isekai'd

152.content: marijuana only exists on earth so no one knows what it is except for Mary Juana and Dealiah
152.name: weed

153.content: Rapunzil Repulse is a merchant's daughter in an arranged political marriage to a husband she finds physically repulsive.
153.name: Rapunzel Repulza - Human

154.content: Celestina is a young female mage who lives and works in Aprida as an adventurer and researcher at the mage guild.
154.name: Celestina - Human mage

155.content:
Feylites are a miniature a miniature race, comprised entirely of females, standing around 30cm tall. They are tiny, half the height of a human's shin, the size of a doll. 
Feylites are reclusive and hide from larger races and creatures. Feylites capture males of smaller magical races such as deimos and pixies for reproduction and their magical abilities. 
Feylites are over twice the height of deimos and pixies, but tiny compared to humans, halflings, elves, etc.
155.name: Feylite

156.content: Dragon Imps are a subspecies of imp with small humanoids bodies around 120cm tall, similar height to dwarf females. They have soft human skin, but with pointed ears, demon horns, clawed lizard feet and claw-like fingernails, often adept with fire magic.
156.name: Dragon imp

157.content: Aluna is a researcher at the Aprida mage guild who is suffering from severe trauma after a freak accident teleported her into an Orc Nest where she was brutally raped.
157.name: Aluna - Human mage

158.content: Sala is a Dragon Imp, a demon imp subspecies, high priestess of the Dragon God cult and regularly preaches to other imps.
158.name: Sala - Dragon Imp

159.content: Mewmi is a catkin girl working as a guard in Madalima prison located on a remote island within the Gatakin Empire.
159.name: Mewmi - Catkin prison guard

160.content: The Gatakin Empire is a collection of various beastkin nations and tribes spread out throughout the Gatakin Archipelago.
160.name: Gatakin Empire

161.content: The Gatakin Archipelago is a tropical island chain located in the South Seas.
161.name: Gatakin Archipelago

162.content: Klezon City is the Capital port city of the Gatakin Empire located on Klezona Isla.
162.name: Klezon City

163.content: Klezon Orphanage is ran by local monks and is located near the slums.
163.name: Klezon - Orhpanage

164.content: Madilima Isla AKA Madalima Prison is a tiny fortified desert island located in the Gatakin Archipelago where criminals from the Gatakin Empire are held.
164.name: Madilima Prison

165.content: Klezona Isla is the largest island of the Gatakin Archipelago.
165.name: Klezon Isla

166.content: Fumae is a satyr girl who hails from the remote snowy mountain range of the Great Forest. She has grey eyes and silver hair.
166.name: Fumae - Satyr

167.content: The Satyr are common among the forests of the world. They have horns, hooves, their ears and noses are sensitive. They will often befriend nymphs, fairies and other whimsical creatures but shy away from more dominant races such as humans, orcs and goblins.
167.name: Satyr

168.content: Fumae's cave is in a remote, hidden location in the western mountain range of the great forest. It is cozy, with a fire pit, fur rugs, wooden bowls and utensils carved by Fumae herself. The entrance to the cave is blocked by a pile of rocks and moss for insulation and a wooden door.
168.name: Fumae - Satyr

169.content: Nala the Needle is a catkin pirate girl. She has short silver hair, a bushy tail and yellow eyes. Her nickname comes from her ability to sail through treacherous waters as if threading a needle and her lightning reflexes with dual shortswords.
169.name: Nala - Catkin

170.content: Lingid Cove is a secret pirate cove on Lingida Isla.
170.name: Lingid Cove

171.content: Lingida Isla is a small desert island and secret base of a group of pirates operating in the Gatakin Archapelago.
171.name: Lingida Isla

172.content: Kaina the cannon is a Gatakin catkin girl who earned her nickname due to her prosthetic cannon leg and makes a living as a mercenary and enforcer.
172.name: Kaina - Catkin

173.content: Siru is a young human woman and coordinator of the adventurer guild in Aprida.
173.name: Siru - Human

174.content: Dealiah was originally a human student and drug dealer from Earth. But was Isekai'd into this strange fantasy world. She is ignorant of the world and it's creatures, races and customs. She is petite with black hair, dark eyes and pale skin.
174.name: Dealiah - Human - Isekai'd

175.content: Pedina Vial is a beautiful wood elf woman who lost her family and friends many centuries ago when her village was burned down by orcs and goblins.
175.name: Pedina - Elf

176.content: Azhra is a powerful dark elf witch and loyal subordinate to her overlord. She is cunning, beautiful.
176.name: Azhra - Overlord minion

177.comment: Kemosuri Oni tribe member: Kuji, witch.
177.content: Kuji is a petite Oni with shoulder length black hair and red eyes. Kuji is a member of the Kemosuri Oni tribe.
177.name: Kemosuri Oni tribe member: Kuji, witch.

178.comment: Kemosuri Oni tribe member: Noiru, Katana wielder
178.content: Noiru is an Oni swordswoman with long black hair an athletic body. Noiru is a member of the Kemosuri Oni tribe.
178.name: Kemosuri Oni tribe member: Noiru, Katana wielder

179.content:
(Greenskin orcs, aka orks, are great hulking masses of muscle that live in nomadic warbands spending all of their time hunting, raiding and fighting. Dey are hostile to all other races but will sometimes tolerate goblins seeking to join their warband. "As long as dey know der place."
"WE'RE DA MEANEST AND GREENEST 'DERE IZ !" An Ork, presumably)
179.name: Orc Tribes

180.content: The Kemosuri are a nomadic tribe of oni, native to Southern portion of the continent. They roam the wastes, jungles and coast hunting and taming great beasts. The Kemosuri are warlike, valuing strength above all else and often come into conflict with other races.
180.name: Kemosuri Oni Tribe

181.content: Oni, aka ogres are a race similar in appearance to humans with the potential to grow taller and stronger on average. They have horns, pointed ears and fiery eye colours. To humans and most other races they are feared as demons and treated as such. However, despite their appearance the Oni are native to the earth plane and not demonic in nature.
181.name: Oni / Ogres

182.content: Pallana is a female oni of the Kemosuri tribe. She is a talented scout and warrior often seen mounted atop powerful demonbeasts. Pallana is of average build with horns, red eyes and short hair.
182.name: Pallana - Oni

183.content: From everyone else's perspective Nyani appears to be a petite Catkin girl with pink hair. They have no idea of her true nature an avatar controlled remotely by Nick Bird, a neckbeard from another plane of existance.
183.name: Nyani - Catkin

184.content: Yala is a beautiful catkin girl with pink hair and fluffy ears. She is popular with many admirers.
184.name: Yala - Catkin

185.content: Female owlkins regularly lay eggs and carry them around even if they're unfertilized.
185.name: Owlkin - Eggs

186.content: Owlkins build ground nests in hidden locations to incubate their fertilized eggs, but will abandon the nest and carry the eggs with them if their nest is discovered.
186.name: Owlkin - Nest

187.content: [Mallow is an owl imp with black feathers, pale skin and two huge horn shaped feather tufts atop her head. She is small and eerily beautiful but her mannerisms are unsettling and strange to other races]
187.name: Mallow - Owlkin

188.content: Phalliz is a doctor specializing in the male reproductive organ. Phalliz is petite human girl with long black hair. She was hit by a truck on her way home and was killed instantly. She reincarnated in this new fantasy world with memories of her previous life on Earth. Phalliz is ignorant of this fantasy world, it's races, creatures, places and customs.
188.name: Phalliz

189.content: Serenity is a beautiful human girl who loves to surf. She was hit by a truck on her way home and was killed instantly. She reincarnated in this new fantasy world with memories of her previous life on Earth. Serenity is ignorant of this fantasy world, it's races, creatures, places and customs.
189.name: Serenity

190.content: Catkin are unheard of in the human lands and most people will be shocked to see one. Most humans, elves, dwarves and halflings have never seen a Catkin before.
190.name: Race Relations - Human, Beastkin

191.content: Humans are unheard of in the Gatakin Archipelago and most people will be shocked to see one. Most catkins have never seen a human before.
191.name: Race Relations - Catkin, Humans

192.content: Jiji is an otherworldly cute blonde, blue eyed human girl. Due to the power granted her by the goddess, anyone who see's Jiji is afflicted by a charm, causing them to fall in love with her. If Jiji is wearing her mask her charm is surpressed and Jiji's presence is hidden.
192.name: Jiji

193.content: The Iza Shrine is a large shrine on the outskirts of Klezon City. It is looked after by a group of catkin monks and shrine maidens who practice martial arts.
193.name: Iza Shrine

194.content: Chichi is an adorable stray kitten that Momo now keeps as a pet. Chichi follows Momo everywhere and meows loudly for attention when left alone. Momo is very attached to Chichi and confides in her emotionally.
194.name: Momo - Chichi

195.content: Momo is a petite blind human girl whom is originally from Earth and reincarnated in this new world after being hit by a truck. She is ignorant of this world, it's customs, races, creatures and cultures.
195.name: Momo

196.content: Demon beast is a broad term for dangerous monsters and creatures.
196.name: Demon Beast

197.content: Bernen is a dwarven mining village in the South of the Human Lands.
197.name: Bernen - Mining Village - Human Lands

198.content: Daila is a petite dwarf girl and D ranked adventurer. She has brown hair and eyes and wields a crossbow and short spear.
198.name: Daila - Dwarf

199.content: Rock Lizards are a D Ranked demon beast, a gargantuan lizard with stone-like scales, able to melt rock and bone with it's acidic saliva. It feeds primarily on minerals but eats humans and other creatures too. Their weakness is their slow predictable movements.
199.name: Rock Lizard - Demon Beast

200.content: Flamburg is a kingdom on the western edge of the human lands, bordering the wilderness of the Great Forest and Southern Wastes. The kingdom is on friendly terms with it's neighbours as it is viewed as a buffer against the demons and monsters of the untamed lands.
200.name: Kingdom of Flamburg

201.content: Koyami is a princess of the Gatakin Empire. Koyama is petite, smaller than the average human, but appears beautiful, cold, reserved and unapproachable to others. Humans are always surprised by her cat ears and tail when they first meet her.
201.name: Koyami - Catkin fifth Princess

202.content: Duke Pierre Devearux is responsible for Princess Koyami's wellbeing during her stay in Vednelim as she attends the Academy. He sends Koyami an allowance of Flamburg gold coins and has instructed his daughters, Isabella, Amia and Fluera to befriend her.
202.name: Koyami + Pierre Devearux

203.content:
The Mara Labyrinth is a recently discovered dungeon within the Great Forest, not far from the City of Aprida. It is unknown how deep the dungeon goes but it is assumed there are over a hundred floors. 
A walled off camp, managed by the adventurer's guild, has been built around the entrance of the labyrinth where merchants and dungeon diving adventurers have gathered.
203.name: Mara Labyrinth

204.content: Zelye is a petite human girl with white hair and red eyes whom sells potions.
204.name: Zelye - Potion seller

205.content: The old gods are ancient eldritch horrors that cannot even be comprehended by mortal races.
205.name: Old Gods

206.content: Kharva is a female Oni warrior of the Kemosuri tribe, expert mounted archer and demon beast rider.
206.name: Kharva - Oni - Kemosuri tribe

207.content: Frogkin are an amphibious beastkin subspecies native to swamps, bogs, rainforests and wetlands. They have webbed feet and hands, projectile tongues and powerful legs.
207.name: Frogkin

208.content: Priid is a river that originates from the Mountain ranges of the Great Forest and passes through the Human lands through the city of Aprida, Cradelle, the Royal Capital of Flamburg and beyond.
208.name: River Priid

209.content: Phibian is a frogkin girl hailing from the Swamps of the Southern Jungle
209.name: Phibian

210.content: House Lévuant is a petty noble family with no holdings.
210.name: House Lévuant -------- WIP ---------

211.content: [The Great Swamp aka Southern Swamp is a vast impassable wetland bordering the Great Wastes and Southern Jungle filled with poisonous flora, disease and dangerous predators]
211.name: Southern Swamp

212.content: Fialova Lévuant is a petty noble girl. A mediocre white mage, avoided by other adventurers, she struggles to find parties to join due to her terrible personality.
212.name: Fialova Lévuant

213.content: Sizzlani has trouble shapeshifting and hiding her wings, tail or flaming horns and is often mistake for an evil demon by ignorant humans, halflings and dwarves.
213.name: Sizzlani

214.content: Grillina is better at shapeshifting than her sister and often takes the appearance of a beautiful human girl with silver hair.
214.name: Grillina

215.content: Sizzlani and Grillina are dragonoid sisters that have found themselves as refugees in the Human lands. Draganoids are a rare and shocking sight to humans when in their dragonoid forms and cause a spectacle in human public spaces.
215.name: Draganoid Sisters Sizzlina and Grillina

216.content: Dragon Grill, owned by Seariosa, is a restaurant in Cradelle, the royal capital of Flamburg, famous for the Dragonoid sisters who work there using their flaming hot bodies to grill the food in front of customers.
216.name: Dragon Grill

217.content: Cradelle is the Royal Capital of Flamburg located in the center of the kingdom along the river Priid
217.name: Cradelle - Flamburg Royal Capital

218.content: Seariosa is formidable human woman, retired adventurer and owner of the famed Dragon Grill Restaurant.
218.name: Seariosa
